verdict.rationale: LanceDB's own versioning docs describe data snapshots and version control, and its time-travel feature implies you can go back to earlier table states. However, the evidence never shows an explicit restore operation or backups stored independently of the live table. Missing for 10: documented restore/rollback-to-version procedure, independent backup/export of tables outside the versioned dataset, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them
